description: Renames the schema-scoped types via directives, two of them while columns are typed by them. The policy is Error: a rename carries the columns typed by the renamed type with it, so nothing destructive belongs in the plan. It used to also re-state each column's type as an AlterColumn, which is why this scenario once had to allow them. SQL Server sees only the two types it has.

sqlite.because: SQLite has none of these types, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
